title: Veal Oscar
description: Crumbed and deep-fried veal topped with blanched asparagus, seafood Mornay, and melted cheese — finished under the grill. A classic fine dining preparation.

method.instruction: Pound veal escalopes until thin and even. Dust lightly with flour, dip in beaten egg, and coat thoroughly with breadcrumbs.
Heat oil to 170–180°C. Deep-fry crumbed veal for 2–3 minutes until golden and crisp. Drain on paper towels and place in an ovenproof dish.
Lay blanched asparagus spears over the veal.
Make the Mornay sauce: melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add flour and whisk for 1–2 minutes to cook the roux until pale golden.
Gradually add warmed milk, whisking constantly until smooth and thickened. Remove from heat and stir in grated cheese until melted. Season with salt.
Gently fold seafood into the Mornay sauce and warm through.
Spoon the seafood Mornay over the veal and asparagus. Top generously with extra grated cheese.
Grill under a hot grill until the cheese is golden and bubbling, about 3–4 minutes. Serve immediately.

notes.title: Crumbed and Fried
notes.content: The veal is crumbed and deep-fried — flour, egg wash, breadcrumbs. This gives a crisp, golden shell that holds up under the rich Mornay without going soggy.

notes.title: Mornay Base
notes.content: This uses the same Mornay sauce base as Reef and Beef. No demi glace is used in this dish — the richness comes from the cheese and seafood.
